title: Protein Language Models Capture Structural and Functional Epistasis in a Zero-Shot Setting
summary: Preprint: epistasis as a lens on what protein language models learn. Raw PLM scores align with residue-residue contacts, and a nonlinear transformation shifts the signal toward functional couplings between distant sites.
authors: Ananthan Nambiar; Sayantani B. Littlefield; Carlos Cuellar; Rohit Khorana; Sergei Maslov
